text: A maths mentor at the tip of your pen. Press a key while you work by hand: Claude, Gemini or GPT marks your work on the screen like a teacher with coloured pens, gives you hints instead of answers, and shows the idea as a 3Blue1Brown-style animation. Handwriting in xournal++ → one key → the slip is marked on the page → box the integral → an interactive manim animation. ( video ; for a repeatable recording the pen is scripted and the model's answer is a fixed example.) I study calculus with a pen tablet in xournal++. I kept screenshotting my work into Claude and reading long answers back, when what I wanted was a teacher looking over my shoulder: circle the mistake, tick what's right, nudge me toward the next step, and show me why. penmentor is that, one key away, on my own Claude subscription. penmentor runs on the AI command-line agent you already use, on that subscription. Pick the model in Settings ; its prefix says which agent answers: Settings lists the agents you have installed. How each one is run and what it sees: the guide . git clone https://github.com/AbdullahAlhariri/penmentor ~ /src/penmentor ~ /src/penmentor/bin/penmentor --selftest Linux on X11 (best with i3), with one of those agents logged in ( claude , codex or agy ), plus rofi , slop , xdotool and PyQt6.
